description: This is a Java Spring MVC Controller class named StoreLandingController, which handles HTTP requests related to the store landing page in an admin web application. It includes methods for displaying and saving store landing page content, managing content descriptions, and setting menu attributes.

classes.name: StoreLandingController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller for managing store landing page content in the admin section.

methods.name: displayStoreLanding
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the store landing page management UI, fetching existing content and preparing descriptions per language.

methods.name: saveStoreLanding
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save the store landing page content, updating or creating content descriptions and persisting the content.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Private utility method to set the menu attributes in the model for UI navigation.
